text:
alex: heads up — customer workload with very long contexts (windowed ~800k tokens active) is steadily increasing host KV memory over 72h, p95 mem up ~28%. page-walk and eviction churn spiking.
jordan: saw a similar pattern on staging yesterday after the model switch. do we have pprof traces?
sam: got CPU+mem pprofs, KV pagewalk counters and reuse hit/miss. early numbers: reuse_miss_ratio=0.62, frag_ratio=0.34, pagewalks/s=4300.
monika: that frag_ratio is alarming for a multi-tenant servo. is the growth due to longctx KV leakage or just cold hotset expansion?
alex: dumps look like many tiny pinned pages from stream updates — not freeing because lease logic keeps them resident for longctx tenants. eviction is thrashing small slabs.
jordan: ran a quick noisy-neighbor sim (40% tenants longctx, 60% short). tail latency for short-tenants doubled when longctx set kept soft-lease=120s.
sam: experiment 1: reduce soft lease window + enable background compaction on per-shard freelist. config snippet we used:
```
kv:
  tenant_quota_bytes: 12GB
  soft_residency_ms: 30000
  compaction_rate_bytes_per_s: 5242880
  lease_eviction_batch: 128
```
monika: results?
sam: pagewalks/s dropped 4300 -> 1200, frag_ratio 0.34 -> 0.18, reuse_miss_ratio -> 0.45. short-tenant p99 latency back within SLO.
eviction-bot: note: canary applied to 5 nodes in us-west-2 at 2026-03-17T09:12Z.
ops-oncall: are we certain compaction won't regress throughput under high burst?
jordan: measured throughput under synthetic burst — compaction throttle (5MB/s) kept CPU spike <6% and didn't increase queueing. but we should gate by tenant priority.
monika: proposal: implement adaptive lease per-tenant: base lease = min(soft_target, tenant_hotset_ratio * max_lease). also run periodic slab-scan compaction when global_frag>0.25. pseudocode:
```
if global_frag > 0.25:
  for shard in shards: shard.compact(rate=compaction_rate)
for tenant in tenants:
  tenant.lease_ms = clamp(base, min_lease, max_lease*hotset_ratio)
```
alex: + add telemetry: per-tenant resident_bytes, lease_age_hist, slab_frag_ratio, pagewalk_rate. want dashboards before rollout.
sam: I'll push a small metric exporter and a staged canary with opt-in flag.
jordan: next steps: 1) dashboard PR (sam) 2) implement adaptive lease logic (monika) 3) load test + noisy-neighbor sim (jordan) 4) canary config push (ops-oncall).
monika: also file note: compaction interacts poorly with KV pinning for long-context decode — we need a test that replays real decode patterns.
ops-oncall: ack, will coordinate canary window and rollback hooks.
alex: thanks — circle back after the first canary run, share pprof + dashboards. :thumbsup:
